name: EventHelpr
description: EventHelpr is a free online tool for planning group events such as trips, meetings, or workshops. It lets you share schedules, locations, and collect feedback from participants to make decisions together.

personas.name: Organizer
personas.description: An organizer planning a group vacation who uses the app to suggest several destination options, start a group discussion, and let everyone vote to decide where to go.

tasks.name: Account Registration and Login
tasks.description: Register a new account using your email, then log in with the created credentials.

tasks.name: Event Creation
tasks.description: Create an event by entering a title, uploading an image, adding a description, and selecting the date. Then save it.

tasks.name: Enable Decision Support
tasks.description: Enable a pro/ con analysis and allow group participants to add ideas for collaborative decision-making.

tasks.name: Add Initial Options
tasks.description: Add three potential destinations to start the discussion and allow participants to give feedback.

personas.name: Participant
personas.description: A group member joining the vacation who uses the app to view the suggested destinations, join the discussion, and vote for their favorite option.

tasks.name: Access Event
tasks.description: Access the event without registration by using the provided access key.

tasks.name: Review and Contribute to Discussion
tasks.description: Review the suggested destinations by adding pros and cons for each, and contribute a new option to the discussion.
